    SELECT account_id FROM loan WHERE date = '1993-07-05' ORDER BY date ASC LIMIT 1
),
bal_a AS (
    SELECT balance FROM trans 
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_account) 
      AND date = '1998-12-27' 
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC LIMIT 1
),
bal_b AS (
    SELECT balance FROM trans 
    WHERE account_id = (SELECT account_id FROM first_loan_account) 
      AND date = '1993-03-22' 
    ORDER BY trans_id DESC LIMIT 1
)

    (CAST((SELECT balance FROM bal_a) AS REAL) - CAST((SELECT balance FROM bal_b) AS REAL)) * 100.0 
    / CAST((SELECT balance FROM bal_b) AS REAL) AS increase_rate

m4_sql:
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'DC Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 
    SUM(CASE WHEN T2.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM 
    superhero AS T1
INNER JOIN 
    publisher AS T2 
ON 
    T1.publisher_id = T2.id
WHERE 
    T2.publisher_name IN ('DC Comics', 'Marvel Comics');
glm_sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics') > SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') THEN 'DC Comics'
    WHEN SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics') > SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics') THEN 'Marvel Comics'
    ELSE 'Equal'
  END AS publisher,
  ABS(SUM(publisher_name = 'DC Comics') - SUM(publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics')) AS difference
FROM superhero
JOIN publisher ON superhero.publisher_id = publisher.id

    SELECT
